subject: Enable Azure private plan + negotiated commercial terms for Nimbus Health
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Azure Marketplace Partner Ops <mpops@microsoft.com>, Samuel Ortiz <samuel.ortiz@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Enable Azure private plan + negotiated commercial terms for Nimbus Health

Hi team,

Following up on our discovery call with Nimbus Health — they are ready to purchase a private plan on Azure but need the transactional and legal setup to match the negotiated commercial points. Key items we agreed with Nimbus:

- Private plan (Azure Marketplace) with subscription billing via Azure (customer pays through their EA)
- Custom unit price: USD 0.004 per token (metered) for first 12 months, then review
- One-time onboarding credit and co-sell uplift: 20% revenue share to co-sell partner (details below)
- Standard SaaS indemnity with a Redwood addendum for data isolation and SOC2 evidence

Attachments: Nimbus_Procurement_Summary.pdf (summary of terms).

Can Azure Marketplace Partner Ops confirm the path: enable private plan, provide the Azure Private Plan form to complete, and confirm whether the commercial redlines below are acceptable or require MS contracting? Also looping Redwood legal for redline review (Monica).

Next actions I propose:
1) Azure confirms enablement steps and expected timelines.
2) Nimbus to provide PO once DocuSign contract is ready.
3) Redwood legal to review redlines and prepare a short two-page addendum to sit on top of Azure Private Plan.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Azure Marketplace Partner Ops <mpops@microsoft.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samuel Ortiz <samuel.ortiz@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 13:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Enable Azure private plan + negotiated commercial terms for Nimbus Health

Rafael — thanks for the summary. We can enable a private plan for Nimbus Health; next steps from our side:

- We need the completed Azure Private Plan form (attached) and the finalized commercial terms (price, billing model).
- For custom pricing and co-sell revenue sharing, the Marketplace contracting team will need to approve the revenue share schedule — share your desired schedule and we will loop contracting.
- Please note: any redlines that change the billing flow (Azure billing vs publisher billing) require approval and may add 2–3 weeks.

Action items for Redwood/Nimbus:
- Upload signed Azure Private Plan form + PO to the portal.
- Share the contract redlines (if any).

Attachment: Azure_PrivatePlan_Form.pdf (fillable).

Regards,
Azure Marketplace Partner Ops
mpops@microsoft.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Enable Azure private plan + negotiated commercial terms for Nimbus Health

Forwarding the Azure response and Nimbus procurement request. I have attached Nimbus's procurement redlines (Nimbus_Redlines_v2.docx). High-level notes from procurement: they want explicit language that billing will flow through Azure (they need chargebacks to their EA), and a 12-month price guarantee. They also asked for data residency assurances and audit log retention details.

Marcus — can you review the redlines and draft a short addendum that we can propose to Azure contracting? Also: we should confirm incentives/co-sell language so Nimbus gets the uplift and Azure has a clear publisher/co-sell registration.

Thanks — Monica

On Tue, Aug 4, 2026 at 9:12 AM Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> (original message included)

Attachment(s): Nimbus_Redlines_v2.docx (docx)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 06 Aug 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Enable Azure private plan + negotiated commercial terms for Nimbus Health

Thanks for the context — I reviewed Nimbus_Redlines_v2.docx and drafted proposed language. High-level summary of Redwood's position:

- Billing: we agree that billing should flow through Azure and not directly through Redwood; however, we need a carve-out that allows Redwood to invoice for professional services (onboarding) if applicable.
- Indemnity: remove overly broad indemnities on Redwood; propose mutual indemnity with a narrower scope limited to breach of confidentiality and IP infringement.
- Data retention/audit logs: we will commit to retention details in the addendum; we cannot accept unlimited audit obligations.
- Term/price: 12-month fixed rate is OK; add a price review clause 60 days before renewal.

I attached Redwood_Azure_Addendum_v1.docx with inline comments and track-changes suggestions (key clauses flagged). Also flagged a commercial ask: recommend a 20% co-sell revenue share for the first 12 months to match the deal economics we promised Nimbus (this is negotiable with Azure contracting).

If Azure contracting insists on publisher-controlled billing, we will need to escalate to leadership to approve a temporary exception.

Attachment: Redwood_Azure_Addendum_v1.docx (draft addendum).

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

From: Samuel Ortiz <samuel.ortiz@nimbushealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Azure Marketplace Partner Ops <mpops@microsoft.com>, Procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Enable Azure private plan + negotiated commercial terms for Nimbus Health

Rafael / Monica — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from Nimbus procurement:

- We confirm we need Azure billing (charge to our EA) — that cannot change.
- We are fine with a 12-month fixed price at USD 0.004 per token and the 20% co-sell uplift to Redwood for the initial period as discussed.
- We would like the DocuSign link to sign the Azure Private Plan + Redwood addendum; procurement will issue a PO once the DocuSign is received.

Outstanding items before signature:
1) Formal confirmation from Azure Partner Ops that the private plan will be enabled and that Azure contracting accepts the proposed revenue share (or will negotiate).
2) Finalized addendum from Redwood legal incorporated into the DocuSign bundle.

Can someone confirm the expected timeline? Nimbus needs to go-live for a pilot the week of Aug 24. If we can get DocuSign + PO in the next 7–10 days, that would hit the schedule.

Thanks — Sam Ortiz
Procurement Lead, Nimbus Health
samuel.ortiz@nimbushealth.com
+1 617-555-0133
